text:
sarah_sales: Heads up — Acme POC asking for partner discount + MDF on top of the standard reseller margin. Can we stack 15% reseller + 10% partner rebate + 5% MDF co-invest? Need answer by EOD. cc @jordan_partnerships
ben_deals: Short answer: policy caps total channel discounts at 25% unless deal-desk/CFO approves. 15+10 = 25 ok, MDF is usually treated as co-invest (not additional margin) but must be pre-approved and logged.
jordan_partnerships: :eyes: who signed off on the 15% reseller? I thought Tier 2 is 12%. Sales doc said 15 verbally.
sarah_sales: We committed 15 because they promised 300k ARR in 12 months (volume commit). I can upload the commit note.
michelle_pm: Also need to confirm whether MDF is calculated pre- or post-discount for forecasting. We treat MDF as separate budget line (co-op) rather than a markup reduction.
ben_deals: Looping in deal-desk: @legal_bot @margins_bot — need exception approval for reseller margin increase to 15% + MDF 5% co-invest for Acme POC. Docs: https://redwood.app/sales/deals/ACME-POC
margins_bot: Auto-note: current catalog reseller tiers = 10% / 12% / 15% for Tiers 1/2/3. Policy: combined channel discounts (reseller + partner rebate) <= 25% without CFO approval. MDF treated separately but must be pre-approved and recorded. See /policies/partner-discounts.pdf
legal_bot: If total discount >25% or terms include atypical credits/trials we need to review SOW + any exclusivity or indemnity clauses. Please attach SOW and security questionnaire outputs.
sarah_sales: Uploading SOW now. POC will likely request on-prem inference for data residency — security questionnaire in progress, ETA ~24h.
michelle_pm: Quick deal math snippet to sanity-check margins:
```
List price (approx): $0.02/token
Estimated monthly tokens: 200M
Gross rev: $4,000
15% reseller = $600
10% partner rebate = $400
MDF 5% = $200 (co-invest)
Net to Redwood = $2,800
```
Numbers rough — finance please validate.
ben_deals: Finance flag: if net < $3k/month and we provide Dedicated capacity, margins look tight. Suggest conditional: start POC on Hosted (metered) until commit triggers Dedicated or reserved capacity.
jordan_partnerships: Can we structure MDF as marketing co-op (reimbursed based on leads/qualified pipeline) instead of an upfront discount? That keeps margin cleaner.
sarah_sales: I like that. Proposed compromise for Acme: 15% reseller + 8% partner rebate + 5% MDF co-op (reimbursed on qualified leads) => effective ~23%. Approvals?
margins_bot: Request logged as ticket P-2026-145. Deal-desk review ETA 48h. Use form: https://redwood.app/dealdesk/request
ben_deals: :thumbsup: Filing ticket now. Tagging @legal_bot for SOW review and @michelle_pm for POC infra constraints.
legal_bot: Received SOW. Quick note: include the standard DPA. If they push for an on-prem install add an appendix limiting liabilities. I'll start review and flag anything unusual.
michelle_pm: POC infra note: we can offer secure Hosted VPC + customer-managed keys to avoid full on-prem install. Technical contact: ryan-eng.
sarah_sales: Thanks — will propose co-op route and Hosted VPC fallback. If deal-desk approves I'll lock terms and share final quote SKUs. Please append approvals to the ticket.
ben_deals: One more: if deal-desk asks for compensating commit, can we convert MDF into performance credit tied to the license commit? Finance prefers credits over straight discounts.
jordan_partnerships: Sounds good — flexible on our end. Ping me if they want a counter-proposal.
